definitions.explanation: Describes an accommodation plan or package whose price covers the evening meal. Used attributively with の or as a predicate, and contrasted on booking sites with breakfast-only and room-only plans.

examples.japanese: {夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}きのプランを{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose a plan with dinner included.

examples.japanese: この{料金|りょうきん}は{夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}きですか。
{到着|とうちゃく}が{遅|おそ}くなるので、{夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}きではないプランにした。
examples.english: We'll be arriving late, so we went with a plan that doesn't include dinner.

examples.japanese: {夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}きの{宿|やど}は{便利|べんり}だが、{周辺|しゅうへん}の{店|みせ}で{食|た}べる{楽|たの}しみはなくなる。
examples.english: An inn with dinner included is convenient, but you lose the fun of eating at places nearby.

notes:
The 〜{付|つ}き suffix means 'comes with' and attaches freely to nouns: {朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き, {送迎付|そうげいつ}き, {保証付|ほしょうつ}き. Note the reading is つき, not ふき.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}きプラン: a dinner-included plan
- {夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}きで{予約|よやく}する: to book with dinner included
- {夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}きの{宿|やど}: an inn where dinner is provided

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き: with breakfast — the business-hotel default
- {一泊二食付|いっぱくにしょくつ}き: one night with dinner and breakfast — the {旅館|りょかん} standard
- {素泊|すど}まり: room only
